description: Search mainland China's national laws, administrative regulations, local regulations, and judicial interpretations (司法解释) by title or keyword — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Chinese law on X", "中国法律", citation lookup, or finding a statute's official record id. Source: NPC National Database of Laws and Regulations (全国人大常委会法工委). Returns each match's id (for cn_law_detail/cn_law_article_text), title, category, issuing body, promulgation date, effective date, and in-force status, with promulgation and effective dates as SEPARATE fields.

category.description: Restrict to one category. "judicial_interpretation" covers SPC/SPP/jointly-issued 司法解释. Default "any".

exact.description: true = exact title match (use for a known law name); false/omitted = fuzzy word-segmented search (broader, can include partial matches).

query.description: Title/keyword in Chinese, e.g. "个人信息保护法", "公司法", "数据安全法".

name: cn_search_laws
title: Cn Search Laws
